text.title: ASP.NET Core Patterns Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable signals to a rule from `content/01-core-rules.xml`. The first three branches are scope gates; the rest route a concrete defect signal. Every leaf names either a rule id or `skip-this-methodology` when the case is out of scope. Max depth = 2.

decision-tree.root-question: Is the service .NET 8/9 and in scope — and if so, which observable signal best describes the artefact under review?

conclusion.verdict: skip-this-methodology: Generic Host, async-by-default and DI assumptions do not hold on .NET Framework 4.x
skip-this-methodology: Minimal APIs suffice; three layers around one method is overkill

branch.question: Does a controller access DbContext directly or hold domain logic?

conclusion.verdict: introduce a service layer; the controller calls one service method

branch.question: Is DbContext registered as singleton or transient, or injected into a singleton?

conclusion.verdict: register as scoped via AddDbContext<T>; resolve a scope for singleton consumers

branch.question: Does an async method lack CancellationToken, or fail to pass it to EF Core?

conclusion.verdict: add CancellationToken as the last parameter; pass it to every EF Core call

branch.question: Are raw exceptions, ad-hoc strings or a bespoke error envelope returned to clients?

conclusion.verdict: register a global IExceptionHandler and return RFC 7807 ProblemDetails

branch.question: Does a service return a tracked EF entity or a navigation property?

conclusion.verdict: map to a record DTO at the boundary; never return navigation properties

branch.question: Did a DTO change without the mapping being verified at build time?

conclusion.verdict: migrate to Mapperly, or add AssertConfigurationIsValid() to a unit test

branch.question: Does an action ship without [Authorize] under an opt-in auth policy?

conclusion.verdict: set RequireAuthenticatedUser() globally; opt out per route with [AllowAnonymous]
restore UseExceptionHandler → UseHttpsRedirection → UseAuthentication → UseAuthorization → MapControllers

branch.question: Is DateTime.UtcNow called directly in business logic?

conclusion.verdict: inject TimeProvider; use FakeTimeProvider in tests

branch.question: Does a read-only query run with change tracking on?

conclusion.verdict: add AsNoTracking() to the read query

branch.question: Is lazy loading enabled or is a navigation property accessed implicitly?
Is pagination using Skip/Take on a large table?

conclusion.verdict: switch to keyset pagination ordered by the primary key

branch.question: Are multi-step writes lacking an explicit transaction?
Are integration tests using EF InMemory?
Do tests use MockBehavior.Default and assert no call counts?

conclusion.verdict: use MockBehavior.Strict with Verify, or cover it with an integration test

branch.question: Do Result<T> wrappers and thrown domain exceptions both reach controllers?

conclusion.verdict: pick one style; reject diffs that reintroduce the other
signal does not match; route to a different methodology or proceed without this one

text.example: Observable: dotnet_version >= 8 AND signal == async-without-ct → conclusion: cancellation-token-threaded.

section.title: Usage
section.p: Apply the tree top-to-bottom against the artefact (PR diff, config, design doc). The two scope gates are evaluated first; then the first matching signal branch is decisive. If several signal branches match, fix in the order listed — later fixes typically depend on earlier ones.
